mapper.select: SELECT * FROM basic_menu_role ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT mr.id, mr.menu_id, m.menu_nm, mr.role_id, r.role_code, mr.can_read, mr.can_create, mr.can_update, mr.can_delete FROM basic_menu_role mr JOIN basic_menu m ON mr.menu_id = m.id JOIN basic_role r ON mr.role_id = r.id ORDER BY r.role_code ASC, m.sort_order ASC, m.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE basic_menu_role SET can_read = #{canRead}, can_create = #{canCreate}, can_update = #{canUpdate}, can_delete = #{canDelete}, updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN #{permissionType} = 'READ' THEN mr.can_read WHEN #{permissionType} = 'CREATE' THEN mr.can_create WHEN #{permissionType} = 'UPDATE' THEN mr.can_update WHEN #{permissionType} = 'DELETE' THEN mr.can_delete END AS permission_yn FROM basic_menu_role mr JOIN basic_role r ON mr.role_id = r.id JOIN basic_menu m ON mr.menu_id = m.id WHERE r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND m.api_path = #{apiPath} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT m.menu_path, m.api_path, mr.can_read, mr.can_create, mr.can_update, mr.can_delete FROM basic_menu_role mr JOIN basic_role r ON mr.role_id = r.id JOIN basic_menu m ON mr.menu_id = m.id WHERE r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE'
